We have always grown enset and some fruit on this small plot, intercropped as we do in SNNP. I do not buy chemical fertilizer for these perennial plants; we use cow manure and compost from around the homestead instead. My family will spend about fifteen days working here this season, and I will not hire outside labor or buy improved seed when our own suckers and seedlings grow well enough.
